design.scope: Synthetic discrete multistep transitions in one frame; no external task, general planning or learning claim
design.transfer: Unseen nuisance values and distinct episode/source ids; same causal law, frame and plan library
design.training: Each train state records one controlled treatment/control pair for energize, unjam, unlock and release; reset and force are never trained

baseline.prediction: Persistence: the plan leaves the input state unchanged
baseline.modelFreePlanner: Cheapest receiver-policy-allowed plan from the same library, without a learned model
baseline.singleStepPlanner: I3 CausalSimulator.proposeActions over single library actions; cheapest supported candidate

primary.prediction: Full final-state accuracy of the case probe plan; UNKNOWN scores 0
primary.planning: Goal reach of the selected plan executed in the environment

design.uncertainty: Conservative bounded synthetic case score: mean(delta)-sqrt(2*log(20)/n) on 0/1 outcomes; cost is reported as mean and per-case non-inferiority; no real-task population CI claim

metrics.calibration: NOT_MEASURED: the support score is not a probability; with zero false transitions a reliability curve has no information

negativeControls: no supported plan reaches the goal
design.promotion: No automatic model, plan or graph-rule promotion; KEEP is experimental only
